summary: Iteration 3 verified: biometric bug fix (in-app modal replaces Alert), breach check endpoint, camera attachment buttons, security rescan, VauLt logo/branding. Backend: 33/33 pytest passing (5 new breach tests added). Frontend: all critical testIDs present, biometric modal shows 'Not available in browser' message on click — NOT silent (user complaint resolved).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use 'boxShadow') and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use 'style.pointerEvents'). Non-blocking, likely from libs (LinearGradient/react-native-web). Reference: browser console.

action_items: (Optional) Address deprecated 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' style-prop warnings on react-native-web — cosmetic only, no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/breach/check correctly enforces JWT (401 without token), validates 5-char hex prefix (400 on bad input), calls real HIBP with Add-Padding header, and returns {suffixes: text}. K-anonymity preserved — client sends only prefix.

settings.tsx enableBiometric() short-circuits with Platform.OS === 'web' → showModal path BEFORE calling LocalAuthentication, guaranteeing visible feedback in browser preview (root cause of iteration 1&2 silent-toggle bug now resolved).
InfoModal uses React Native <Modal> with testID='info-modal-ok' on CTA — reliable on react-native-web (verified via automation).
auth.tsx logo uses require('../assets/images/icon.png') with expo-image — renders on load; hero and 'Made by V.' credit both visible.
entry/[id].tsx renders 4 attachment pressables with distinct testIDs and passes source ('camera' vs 'gallery') into uploadMedia — matches problem statement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all requested flows (biometric modal, breach rescan, 4 attachment buttons, VauLt logo)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users per run (email prefix 'biotest_'/'test_'). No persistent seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 33 cases across TestHealth/Auth/Vault/AuthGuard/UserSalt/GoogleSession/KdfSaltPut/Files/Sessions/UserIdFormat/BreachCheck. Breach endpoint uses live HIBP (https://api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/{prefix}) with Add-Padding. Frontend key testIDs verified in iter3: settings-biometric (card), biometric-action-btn (button — no longer a Switch), info-modal-ok (dismisses in-app modal), security-rescan, att-capture-photo, att-add-image, att-capture-video, att-add-video. Biometric on web ALWAYS shows modal with 'Not available in browser' — hardware checks are bypassed on web.
rca_of_issue: User complaint 'biometric activation still doesn't work' — RCA: iterations 1&2 used Alert.alert which react-native-web renders as an in-DOM overlay Playwright cannot always detect; some browser instances suppressed it entirely. Fix in iter3: (1) Switch replaced with a Pressable (testID biometric-action-btn); (2) enableBiometric() checks Platform.OS === 'web' FIRST and calls showModal() → InfoModal component with testID info-modal-ok. Verified via Playwright: click button → modal visible with 'Not available in browser' title and correct message → OK dismisses cleanly. Fix is stable.
